mapping.summary: Two-way sync of products, stock, prices, customers, orders and returns with Shopify.
claims: Pushes products, variants, images, metafields, metaobjects and collections to Shopify
Pushes stock per location, optionally with unit cost
Applies base prices and customer-group price lists, with optional SparkLayer routing for B2B
Posted BC shipments fulfil Shopify orders, including click-and-collect and in-store pickup
Writes confirmations and invoices back to Shopify and marks orders paid when the invoice is settled
Syncs B2C contacts and B2B company accounts with contacts, locations and catalogues
Imports orders in real time via webhooks with tag or source filters and split fulfilment
Credit memos become Shopify refunds and Shopify refunds become BC return orders, with Narvar integration
Propagates Shopify product IDs and deletions back to BC
Imports third-party fulfilments from Shopify as BC sales shipments with tracking
Supports Shopify B2B with ship-to locations, roles and price lists
Includes a portal to monitor flows, get alerts and resubmit failed transactions
